# Ship acme-api

Decided by the team: Ostrom enforces it in this session.

## A change is ready to ship (trigger)

## Write the commit message the team way (step)

One line, imperative.

Rules for this step:
- Commit messages start with a verb in the imperative. (r-commit-style)

## Unit tests pass (check)

Before push-main, Ostrom runs `npm test` in a sandbox (no network, no secret). If it fails, the action is refused with the output: fix the cause, never skip or weaken the check, then run the same command again.

## Second (agent)

Hand this step to a sub-agent where your agent has them: `ostrom-second` in Claude Code; in Codex, spawn_agent with agent_type `ostrom_second` (and task_name `ostrom_second`). Otherwise do it yourself. Then call `node_done` (MCP server "ostrom-workflow") with node "wf-ship-second" and a one-line summary of what was really done; never report a sub-agent that did not run.

Read the diff once more.

## Second look (agent)

Hand this step to a sub-agent where your agent has them: `ostrom-second-look` in Claude Code; in Codex, spawn_agent with agent_type `ostrom_second_look` (and task_name `ostrom_second_look`). Otherwise do it yourself. Then call `node_done` (MCP server "ostrom-workflow") with node "wf-ship-review" and a one-line summary of what was really done; never report a sub-agent that did not run.

Review the diff.

## Push to main (gate)

A human yes is needed from rev-b or dev-a. When Ostrom refuses the action "waiting for a yes", run the `ostrom wait <id>` command it gives, then the same command again. Never work around a gate.

## Tell the team (notify)

After the action, Ostrom tells releases by itself: do not send the message yourself.
